repair.diagnosis: Sticky promo (84px high, z-index 20, fixed at bottom) overlaps Add to Cart CTA (fixed bottom 16px, z-index 10), so hit test hits promo not CTA
repair.rationale: Moves CTA to 84px promo height + 16px gap above promo, keeping both fully visible in viewport and CTA clickable

repair.diagnosis: Sticky promo overlaps CTA: .sticky-promo is fixed bottom:0 height:84px z-index:20 while .add-to-cart is fixed bottom:16px z-index:10, so promo covers CTA
repair.evidenceSummary: Both mobile (390x844) and desktop (1280x800) show ctaInViewport:true but mobile/desktopNotObscured:false and Clickable:false, hitElement id sticky-promo, hitIsCta:false, clickOk:false; CTA bottom area lies within promo's 84px bottom band
repair.rationale: Raise CTA 16px above the 84px-high sticky promo (84+16=100) so it is fully visible and clickable in viewport without hiding or removing CTA or promo

repair.diagnosis: Cart total uses stale LEGACY_CART_PRICE_MINOR (7900) instead of the canonical catalog price from window.CATALOG, while displayed price correctly uses product.priceMinor.
repair.evidenceSummary: displayedPriceMatchesCatalog=true but cartTotalMatchesCatalog=false; catalog priceMinor=8900 and displayedPriceMinor=8900, yet quantity=2 gives cartTotalMinor=15800 (7900*2) instead of expectedTotalMinor=17800 (8900*2).
repair.rationale: Derives cart unit price at runtime from product, which is looked up from window.CATALOG, without hardcoding 8900 or editing catalog.js, so cart total matches displayed/catalog price.
